SchemaMigrationsPending.description: The database schema is behind the running binary.

raw_key.description: Raw API key secret, returned only when created.

source_app_id.description: Imported onboarding app id, when available.

from_address.description: Default From email address. Empty string when unset.

from_name.description: Default From display name. Empty string when unset.

active_version_id.description: Present after a reviewed version has been published and activated.

text.description: Required for heading, paragraph, and button blocks.

url.description: Required for button and image blocks. Image URLs must use https.

call_to_action_url.description: Absolute http or https URL. Required when call_to_action_label is present.

image_url.description: Absolute https URL for an optional image block.

purpose.description: Defaults to the template purpose when omitted.

wizard_anthropic_gateway_configured.description: Whether the wizard Anthropic gateway has usable server-side configuration.

wizard_openai_gateway_configured.description: Whether the wizard OpenAI gateway has usable server-side configuration.

traits.description: Arbitrary identity traits (e.g. email, name, plan). Merged on each call. Max 50KB.

created.description: True when this call created the user, false when it updated an existing one.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller retry key. Reusing it returns the existing message and does not send again.

template_model.description: Template variables passed to Postmark. Empty object when omitted.

event_type.description: Project event code. Runtime mapping is app-scoped.

occurred_at.description: Optional event timestamp. When omitted, whisp-go uses the receive time.

UpdateDeliveryEmailSettingsRequest.description: Partial update of the email sender identity. Provide at least one of from_name or from_address. An omitted field is left unchanged; an explicit empty string clears it.

from_address.description: A syntactically valid email address, or empty to clear.

UpdateDeliveryEmailTemplateRequest.description: Partial metadata update. Dashboard callers can mark a generated template reviewed; provider publish and active transitions use the version publish endpoint.

info.description:
Lean runtime surface for whisp-go.

Onboarding and setup-time auth are owned by whisp-onboarding-panel. whisp-go
imports a completed onboarding session, materializes runtime context,
events, interventions, variants, and their typed links.

post.description:
Accepts only a completed onboarding session id. whisp-go fetches the
related org, app, business context, intake context, source metadata,
and snapshots from the onboarding Supabase project. Onboarding-generated
interventions and events are context only; whisp-go queues a focused
runtime universe generation job.
